summary: Iteration 31 completed: reusable unit tests added for order-totals/drafts, draft E2E flow validated with TEST fixture, OrderTotals+duplicate+fault scenarios partially validated.

minor.issue: Backend suite not rerun in this iteration (main context already reported backend passing).

ui_bugs.issue: After saving draft from direct route, UI logs navigation warning: 'GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator'.

integration_issues.issue: Duplicate flow opens wizard but logs warning when source order customer is not in current user customer list; customer is skipped in restore.
Could not reliably target an appointment card with mark/undo action in mobile week grid after 3 attempts; only visit modal was consistently opened (no completion action by design).

action_items: Add stable testID to step-1 customer rows, step-2 add buttons (+1/+10), payment/shipping options, and calendar event cells to make mobile E2E deterministic.
Handle draft-save post action safely when no back stack exists (fallback route instead of unconditional router.back()).
Review duplicate flow UX when source customer is not visible to current user (explicit message + safe fallback).
Re-run calendar PATCH fault scenario after adding event-level testIDs for appointment/visit differentiation.
Priority-5 section matrix was not fully executed in this iteration; schedule targeted follow-up runs per module.
critical_code_review_comments: order-collection-v2.tsx is ~2700 lines (>700 rule), making regressions and E2E maintenance harder; should be split into step modules/hooks.
Interactive controls in order wizard and calendar still lack comprehensive testID coverage despite new scoped testIDs elsewhere.
Observed OrderTotals mismatch sample (stored 117,50€ vs calculated 166,90€) confirms component is display-only and does not mutate stored amount; business should verify expected delta semantics.
seed_data_creation: No new persistent business entities created intentionally. Draft created and deleted in-flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable Vitest suite now exists for order totals and drafts. Draft E2E with fixture customer succeeded including resume and delete, and verified no POST /orders during draft save. Orders error retry and calendar GET fault banner succeeded. Calendar PATCH fault remains pending due missing deterministic appointment selector/testID in mobile grid.
rca_of_issue: Calendar PATCH fault reproducibility gap is primarily a testability issue: in mobile week grid, event hit-targets are tiny and text wrapping makes appointment vs visit hard to disambiguate without event-level testIDs. As a result, automation repeatedly opened visit modal (no mark/undo) instead of appointment modal. Mitigation: add explicit event testIDs (type+id) and action testIDs in rendered event cell, then rerun forced PATCH-abort validation.
